checkpoints.title: The build and integration jobs in ci.yml give go test a 30-minute timeout
contracts: .github/workflows/ci.yml job build, step "Build, vet, test": `go test -timeout 30m -coverprofile=coverage.out ./...`
No permission, secret, environment, trigger, or action pin changes; only these two run lines
instrumentation: The build job's go test output: the time of internal/cli (576 s on dev run 40710734386)
checkpoints.rollback: Revert the squash commit; the two go test commands return to go test's 10-minute default.
